# LeanPool polygonal Jordan foundation

These three modules are adapted from [LeanPool/lean-pool](https://github.com/LeanPool/lean-pool), commit `86da5902e640ceb44e53f88c4a04f870dc062126`.

Copyright © 2026 ClassificationOfSurfaces contributors. Authors: Ryan McCorvie and Jack McCarthy. The original copyright and author headers are retained in every source file. The complete Apache-2.0 license is retained in [the shared LeanPool license](../LICENSE).

The imported theorem proves separation of an actual cyclic polygon made from genuine Euclidean segments, including connected bounded and unbounded regions and both frontier equalities. It assumes no separation, inside/outside data or extra fixed-point class. It supplies a reusable foundation; identifying arbitrary project geodesic polygons and proving their angle, convexity and area theorems are separate tasks.

Changes are project-relative module paths, explicit public imports, and nine normalization-tactic refinements that remove informational suggestions. Public namespaces, theorem statements and author credits are retained. `UPSTREAM.json` records upstream Git blob identities, original and adapted SHA-256 hashes, declaration correspondences and exact modules.
